title: AI Gender Swap
summary: Free AI gender swap: turn a photo of yourself into the opposite gender and keep your face recognisable. See real before and after examples and try it free.
body_markdown:
### How do I do an AI gender swap of myself?


Add a clear, front-facing photo of yourself as a reference image, then ask for the same person as the opposite gender, naming the features to keep, such as your eyes, nose, smile and any marks.


### Is there a free AI gender swap?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every gender swap on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I keep my face recognisable in a gender swap?


List the features that stay, such as the eyes, the nose, the smile and any freckles, glasses or marks, and change just the jaw, facial hair and hairstyle.


### Why does my gender swap still look like the original gender?


The model holds on to the reference closely, so name the changes as well as the swap: for a woman, no beard, a softer jaw and longer hair; for a man, a stronger jaw and stubble or a beard.


### Can I see both genders side by side?


Yes. Add your photo as a reference and ask for you and your gender swapped twin in one picture, posing together, so you can compare the two faces at a glance.


### Can I do a gender swap in anime or another style?


Yes. Name the style in the prompt, such as 1990s cel anime, a film photo or an oil portrait, or pick a style from Flickpedia, and the gender swap is drawn in that look.


### Can I turn a gender swap into a video?


Yes. Use the gender swap as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as a laugh or a turn of the head, and ask it to keep the face as it is.
